site_surface.short_summary: Naya is a VM-188 live-pilot Alara shard expression for Green-centered red-green-white abundance, life, growth, belonging, instinct, and larger-picture care.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Naya asks what life becomes when growth, belonging, and instinct trust the living world before control or extraction.
site_surface.tagline: Grow with the world. Move with the bond. Guard the living whole.
best_for: readers drawn to Green-centered abundance and living-world belonging
players who prefer creature-forward growth, instinct, and protective board presence as support texture
reviewers checking that Naya stays separate from generic big creatures, generic tokens, Cabaretti, Selesnya, Gruul, Bant, and Jund
content_warnings_or_sensitivity_notes: Naya material can invite overclaims about named figures, religion, social hierarchy, giant creatures, or Commander products. This packet keeps those topics deferred unless directly evidenced.

core_identity.summary: Naya is the Green-centered red-green-white Alara shard expression whose safe evidence floor is life, nature, growth, ecosystem belonging, White larger-picture duty and life support, Red feral instinct and loyalty, and Blue/Black as missing control and extraction pressures.
core_identity.philosophy: Green supplies the center: life grows into its place in a larger natural whole. White supports larger-picture care for life and creatures. Red supports immediacy, loyalty, and instinctive bond.
core_identity.central_tension: Vox Mana models Naya's tension as abundance and belonging drifting into overgrowth, over-identification with scale, or mistaking instinct for wisdom.
core_identity.interpretive_note: Central-tension and product-language compression are Vox Mana modeling from VM-181 through VM-183. They are not official Wizards or MTG canon.
unknowns: Detailed Naya geography, named locations, settlements, and shard-era travel
Mayael, the Anima, Cylian elves, Nacatl groups, Jazal, Marisi, Progenitus, and Gahiji biography or authority

Conflux, post-Conflux, and post-Phyrexian Naya outcomes

Detailed social structure, named-location politics, and creature-culture hierarchy

structure.summary: The safe structural floor is narrow: Naya is an Alara shard with RGW color-direction metadata, Green as center/design lens, White and Red as ally roles, and Blue/Black as missing pressures at design scope.
supported_elements: Naya as a red-green-white Alara shard
Life as part of a larger natural whole
Ecosystem, role, place, and belonging at design scope
Nature and growth at center stage, pushed to an extreme
White larger-picture duty, life, creatures, and greater-good support
Red feral instinct, immediacy, loyalty, and bond support
Blue and Black as missing pressures at design-philosophy scope only
Boundary against generic big creatures, generic tokens, generic color shorthand, Cabaretti style drift, and Jund-style consumption
review_gated_elements: Commander/operator rows as product support only
Local Scryfall card facts as future claim-by-claim support only
Green, White, Red, Selesnya, Gruul, and Boros articles as color-philosophy support only
Bant, Esper, Grixis, and Jund as comparator rails only
manual_review_required: Do not narrate detailed geography before stronger local evidence is added.
Do not narrate figures, rulers, named groups, or authority before stronger local evidence is added.
Do not narrate Progenitus theology, worldsoul language, Coil worship, or Naya religion before stronger local evidence is added.
Do not turn power 5, enormous creatures, or big-matters gameplay into the whole identity before stronger local evidence is added.
Do not narrate Conflux, post-Conflux, or post-Phyrexian outcomes before stronger local evidence is added.
Do not use Commander products as Naya-world canon.

great_tension.summary: Vox Mana models Naya's great tension as abundance becoming world: life grows into belonging, but growth can become overgrowth, scale can become the whole identity, and instinct can mistake immediacy for wisdom.
great_tension.placement_relevance: VM-188 live-pilot placement note. Use only with VM-181 evidence boundaries and without converting support-only Commander, mechanics, comparator, or manual-fill material into claims.
